en: Black‑and‑white view of a wide cobbled town square or main street flanked by 3–4 story buildings with steep tiled roofs in a Central European style. On the right stands a tall clock‑tower with a tiered baroque/renaissance spire attached to the town hall; further back another ornate building with spires is visible. Pedestrians walk sparsely in the open square, a few carts or early vehicles appear in the distance, and several shop signs in German are visible on the façades.
